# Embla carousel 8.6.0 notice

Pinned npm `embla-carousel@8.6.0` declares MIT and has no runtime dependencies. Its tarball omits
the license file. The adjacent unmodified notice was verified on 2026-10-10 from the matching tag:
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/davidjerleke/embla-carousel/v8.6.0/LICENSE

`scripts/build-carousel-engine.mjs` embeds this notice in every lazy asset. The trusted managed
catalog uses the same notice; changing the npm pin requires re-auditing this source and notice.
